title: myColorado app cybersecurity incident, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by the State of Colorado, any news outlet, regulator, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One statewide app with about 2.1 million users, offline for everyone. The state estimates 50,000 to 150,000 people's data may have been affected; the investigation is ongoing.
who_is_affected: Everyone who uses the myColorado app for a digital driver license, digital ID or state services. Carry your physical ID, including for holiday flights. The state says it will notify people whose data was affected.

known.text: The state says an unauthorized user accessed myColorado platform data, found late on Nov 18.
The state shut the app down and it is still unavailable, with no restoration date.
The state estimates 50,000 to 150,000 people's data may have been affected.
State services are still available through agency websites, and a physical ID is needed meanwhile.
